artifacts.name: AddPolygonField

artifacts.name: Alert

artifacts.name: ApplySLDFile
artifacts.description: Applies the SLD file.  Takes two optional parameters.  The first will determine whether the SLD is linked by section names (true) or billing load (false).  The second will clear the load (true) or apply to current load (false).To call: ApplySLDFile( 'path', linkBySection, clearLoad )

artifacts.name: Complex
artifacts.description: Creates a complex number object. Complex objects can be in the form  real (number), imag (number) or 'real + imag j' (string). This object can be used to perform basic math with other complex objects. Currently supported: +, - (unary and binary), *, /, ^, == and tostring().To call: Complex( real, imag )

artifacts.name: abs
artifacts.description: Calculates the absolute value of the complex. Same as mag.To call: (complex):abs()

artifacts.name: acos
artifacts.description: Calculates the inverse cosine of the complex.To call: (complex):acos()

artifacts.name: acosh
artifacts.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic cosine of the complex.To call: (complex):acosh()

artifacts.name: asin
artifacts.description: Calculates the inverse sine of the complex.To call: (complex):asin()

artifacts.name: asinh
artifacts.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic sine of the complex.To call: (complex):asinh()

artifacts.name: atan
artifacts.description: Calculates the inverse tangent of the complex.To call: (complex):atan()

artifacts.name: atanh
artifacts.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic tangent of the complex.To call: (complex):atanh()

artifacts.name: conj
artifacts.description: Calculates the complex conjugate of the complex.To call: (complex):conj()

artifacts.name: cos
artifacts.description: Calculates the cosine of the complex.To call: (complex):cos()

artifacts.name: cosh
artifacts.description: Calculates the hyperbolic cosine of the complex.To call: (complex):cosh()

artifacts.name: exp
artifacts.description: Calculates the base-e exponential of the complex.To call: (complex):exp()

artifacts.name: imag
artifacts.description: Retrieves the imaginary part of the complex.To call: (complex):imag()

artifacts.name: log
artifacts.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the complex.To call: (complex):log()

artifacts.name: log10
artifacts.description: Calculates the common logarithm of the complex.To call: (complex):log10()

artifacts.name: mag
artifacts.description: Calculates the magnitude of the complex. Same as abs.To call: (complex):mag()

artifacts.name: norm
artifacts.description: Calculates the norm value of the complex.To call: (complex):norm()

artifacts.name: pow
artifacts.description: Calculates the power of the complex. Can take real or complex numbers.To call: (complex):pow( number )

artifacts.name: real
artifacts.description: Retrieves the real part of the complex.To call: (complex):real()

artifacts.name: sin
artifacts.description: Calculates the sine of the complex.To call: (complex):sin()

artifacts.name: sinh
artifacts.description: Calculates the hyperbolic sine of the complex.To call: (complex):sinh()

artifacts.name: sqrt
artifacts.description: Calculates the square root of the complex.To call: (complex):sqrt()

artifacts.name: tan
artifacts.description: Calculates the tangent of the complex.To call: (complex):tan()

artifacts.name: tanh
artifacts.description: Calculates the hyperbolic tangent of the complex.To call: (complex):tanh()

artifacts.name: toPolar
artifacts.description: Converts the complex value to polar form.To call: (complex):toPolar()

artifacts.name: toRectangular
artifacts.description: Converts the complex value to rectangular form.To call: (complex):toRectangular()

artifacts.name: ConnectAll

artifacts.name: addElement
artifacts.description: Allows you to add a new element after a specified element that already exists in the model. For the elementType argument, you may simply use the type of the element which can be found in the Scripts Manager under constants, or in the Scripts directory. (example: for overhead, you would use OH, and for underground you use UG, and so on)To call: (element):addElement( elementType )
artifacts.return: new element or nil on failure to add

artifacts.name: rephase
artifacts.description: Allows you to rephase any element. For the phase argument of this function you may simply type in PHASE_A, PHASE_B, PHASE_C, PHASE_AB, PHASE_AC, PHASE_BC, or PHASE_ABC.  Takes 0 to 3 optional parameters that must be included in succession ex) to include keepPhases, a moveLoadEnum must be included.  MoveLoadEnums are given as an integer (0 = split, 1 = moveFirstPhase, 2 = moveSecondPhase, 3 = leaveLoadAlone, 4 = askUser).  Keep phases and check downline are given as boolean values.To call: (element):rephase( PHASE_*phase*, moveLoadNumber, boolKeepPhases, boolCheckDownline )

artifacts.name: setAltLocation
artifacts.description: NOTE: Only works on disconnected line sections. Noting that the element's alt location is usually its parent's location (or end coordinate), this function allows you to set the x and y values of the alt location. Negative numbers may be used.To call: (element):setAltLocation( X, Y )

artifacts.name: WriteToErrorLog
artifacts.description: Writes an error table (line, file, errCode, message, (optional) GUID) to the Error Log.  Can take two optional boolean parameters (to write to the error file and if the new entries should overwrite previous data in the error file).  The line is where the error occurred.  The file is where the error occurred.  The errCode is a value 1 to 5 (1 = Message, 2 = Warning, 3 = Error, 4 = Fatal Error, 5 = Debug).  The message describes the error.  The GUID is the GUID of the affected element.To call: WriteToErrorLog( errorTable, true, false )
